PLAN "Climber Upper Body Strength — Subacromial Impingement Return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild pain-free upper body strength for climbing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Horizontal Push Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 2x15
          prone_Y 2x12
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          scapular_retraction 2x15
          prone_T 2x12
          prone_W 2x12

          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
